description: Portable R3 analysis and figure-reproduction code supporting the manuscript 'Observing Earth's ionospheric irregularities from the moon'. This selected 182-station release is dated 30 October 2026. Numerical inputs and source data are versioned separately in Zenodo; YunYao profiles requiring provider permission are not publicly redistributed.
